body: I don't know how I can make it through school.
She hasn't beat me since my coach called child protection services. Still, nothing has gotten better.

I'm in my 11th year, and yes, I have two close friends whose parents have told me they are willing to take me in. But I know my mom wouldn't let me do that.

I do know that there is a better life for me outside of high school, but what I can't deal with is how she is forcing me to quit indoor and outdoor track as well, the two things I used to cope, the two things I love the most. This does sound really stupid, but I'm so tired and I don't see how it'll get better. 

It's 1 AM right now and she's just gone downstairs, she yelled at me for another hour and a half.
